'''Cuirreal climbers''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dressel/Legends|Dressel]]. Their meat featured prominently alongside [[Mushroom/Legends|mushrooms]] and the [[Steepara seed|seeds]] and [[Steepara syrup|syrup]] of the [[steepara tree]] in the [[Diet/Legends|diets]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] species.<ref name="SOT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cuirreal climbers were first mentioned in [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']], a supplement released in [[2015]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for their [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] roleplaying game.
